correctness.rationale: Ray-opposition invariant recovers N_f because all nonzero base-pair sums equal t_i and no cross-index base rays can be opposite. Lattice quotient recovers base ray pairs and their intrinsic sums, proving necessity and sufficiency of D6-orbit equivalence; standard maximal-torus conjugacy lifts to abstract iso. Independent base flips generate C2^k and compatible permutations split the symmetry extension. Zero-sum forces three equal signed multiplicity differences; normal forms are bijective with weighted ordered partitions, and known Wuebben KE criterion gives the displayed rational generating functions. Unique order-4 pole at z=1 gives A_k asymptotic. Reproducible exact enumeration independently checks dihedral orbit classification k2..14 and coefficient identities k2..99. Finite checks corroborative not universal proof.

value.rationale: The smooth toric Fano root-twist family is a natural, explicitly defined infinite collection with stable tangent bundles studied in a 2026 paper. An exact invariant of abstract isomorphism, all finite fan symmetry groups, and a single generating function for counts at every dimension turn the paper's nine-dimensional-table sample into a full geometric classification. The asymptotic separation shows that Kähler–Einstein geometry becomes rare inside this stable family; this is a substantive structural distinction about natural classification objects, not an arbitrary numerical slice. The known tangent-stability and KE criteria remain appropriately credited.
